editorial:
Imagine running away from a crime you didn't commit and trying to start over in a sunny city like Los Angeles. That is exactly what happens to the main girl in this flick. She rents a room from a writer, and things get steamy pretty quickly. But the mood shifts from a romance to a nightmare when she realizes someone who looks exactly like her is stalking her and killing people. It feels like a creepy dream where you can't trust your own eyes, and the tension keeps building as the two versions of her clash.

The acting is solid, and the way the mystery unfolds keeps you guessing until the very end. While some parts move a bit slow, the shocks make up for it. If you love old-school thrillers with a weird twist, you will really dig this one.
endingExplained: The big twist is that the double isn't a ghost or a monster, but a real person. It turns out there is a dark family secret involving twins. The double was trying to steal the main character's life and identity completely. In the final showdown, the two face off in a violent fight. The good girl eventually wins, but the movie leaves you wondering if the cycle of madness will ever truly stop for her.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves psychological twists and creepy doubles.
